records.label: spacr.embeddings.embed_array#4
records.source: a callable taking ``(n, height, width, 3)`` float32 in [0, 1] and returning ``(n, dims)``. An encoder with an ``in_channels`` attribute takes that many planes instead, and one whose ``in_channels`` is ``None`` takes any number: each channel alone under the per-channel policy, every encoded channel in one pass under the projection policy. Injected by the tests so the wiring can be exercised without downloading a backbone; production callers leave it ``None``.
records.context: a callable taking ``(n, height, width, 3)`` float32 in [0, 1] and returning ``(n, dims)``. An encoder with an ``in_channels`` attribute takes that many image layers instead, and one whose ``in_channels`` is ``None`` takes any number: each image data channel alone under the per-image data channel policy, every encoded image data channel in one pass under the projection policy. Injected by the tests so the wiring can be exercised without downloading a backbone; production callers leave it ``None``.
records.translation: [0, 1] 범위의 float32 데이터 ``(n, height, width, 3)``를 받아 ``(n, dims)``를 반환하는 호출 가능한 객체다. ``in_channels`` 속성이 있는 인코더는 대신 그 수만큼의 영상 평면을 받으며, ``in_channels``가 ``None``이면 개수에 제한이 없다. 채널별 정책에서는 각 채널을 따로 처리하고, 투영 정책에서는 인코딩되는 모든 채널을 한 번에 처리한다. 백본을 내려받지 않고도 구성 요소의 연결을 검증할 수 있도록 테스트에서 주입하며, 운영 환경의 호출자는 ``None``으로 둔다.

records.label: spacr.psf_pipeline#3
records.source: SPECTRAL UNMIXING COMES FIRST. With ``unmix`` on, a bleed-through matrix is estimated from the single-stain control wells ``unmix_controls`` names and every raw field is unmixed across all its channels before illumination correction, the PSF and the chain; the matrix joins the same record. Measure estimates its own over the measured channels and unmixes each field before its preprocessing hooks, recording the matrix in the saved run settings and ``measurements/bleed_through.json``.
records.context: Spectral unmixing comes first. With ``unmix`` on, a bleed-through matrix is estimated from the single-stain control microplate sample positions ``unmix_controls`` names and every raw microscope field of view is unmixed across all its image data channels before illumination correction, the PSF and the chain; the matrix joins the same record. Measure estimates its own over the measured image data channels and unmixes each microscope field of view before its preprocessing hooks, recording the matrix in the saved processing-session settings and ``measurements/bleed_through.json``.
records.translation: 분광 분리가 가장 먼저 수행됩니다. ``unmix``가 켜져 있으면 ``unmix_controls``가 지정한 단일 염색 대조 웰에서 채널 누출 행렬을 추정하고, 조명 보정, PSF 및 처리 체인 전에 각 원시 시야의 모든 채널을 분리합니다. 이 행렬은 같은 기록에 포함됩니다. 측정은 측정 대상 채널에 대한 자체 행렬을 추정하고 전처리 훅 전에 각 시야를 분리하며, 저장된 실행 설정과 ``measurements/bleed_through.json``에 행렬을 기록합니다.

records.label: spacr.qt.assay_examples#1
records.source: Replication, Invasion, Recruitment and Host–Pathogen offer published datasets through Load test data. Host–Pathogen contains two real THP-1 RNF213 fields, prepared host/nucleus/vacuole masks and fresh measurements of those fields. Replication and Recruitment contain slices of measured screens. Invasion's images are synthetic and explicitly labelled before downloading. Its masks are Cellpose-SAM segmentations from Mask, and its ground truth describes the objects originally drawn into those images.
records.context: Replication, Invasion, Recruitment and Host–Pathogen offer published datasets through Load test data. Host–Pathogen contains two real THP-1 RNF213 microscope fields of view, prepared host/nucleus/vacuole masks and fresh measurements of those microscope fields of view. Replication and Recruitment contain slices of measured screens. Invasion's images are synthetic and explicitly labelled before downloading. Its masks are Cellpose-SAM segmentations from Mask, and its ground truth describes the objects originally drawn into those images.
records.translation: Replication, Invasion, Recruitment 및 Host–Pathogen은 테스트 데이터 불러오기를 통해 공개된 데이터셋을 제공합니다. Host–Pathogen에는 실제 THP-1 RNF213 시야 두 개, 준비된 숙주/핵/액포 마스크와 해당 시야의 새 측정값이 포함됩니다. Replication과 Recruitment에는 측정된 스크리닝의 일부가 포함됩니다. Invasion 이미지는 합성이며 다운로드 전에 명시적으로 표시됩니다. 그 마스크는 Mask의 Cellpose-SAM 분할 결과이며, 정답 데이터는 해당 이미지에 처음 그려진 객체를 설명합니다.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.model_install.SpotDetectorCombo#1
records.source: spaCR's own detector is first, the default and always usable. SpotNet and Spotiflow are listed whether or not they can run; when one's environment (or SpotNet's DeepCell token) is missing its row is disabled and its tooltip says which. SpotNet's tooltip states its non-commercial licence either way, because this box is where a person chooses it. A saved Spotiflow choice is kept even while its row is disabled or hidden, so the run receives it and says why it cannot run rather than detecting with another detector.
records.context: spaCR's own detector is first, the default and always usable. SpotNet and Spotiflow are listed whether or not they can run; when one's environment (or SpotNet's DeepCell token) is missing its row is disabled and its tooltip says which. SpotNet's tooltip states its non-commercial licence either way, because this box is where a person chooses it. A saved Spotiflow choice is kept even while its row is disabled or hidden, so the run receives it and says why it cannot run rather than detecting with another detector.
records.translation: spaCR 자체 검출기가 첫 번째이며 기본값이고 항상 사용할 수 있습니다. SpotNet과 Spotiflow는 실행 가능 여부와 관계없이 나열됩니다. 해당 환경 또는 SpotNet의 DeepCell 토큰이 없으면 그 행이 비활성화되고 툴팁에 무엇이 없는지 표시됩니다. SpotNet의 툴팁은 어느 경우든 비상업적 라이선스를 명시합니다. 사용자가 이 상자에서 선택하기 때문입니다. 저장된 Spotiflow 선택은 행이 비활성화되거나 숨겨져 있어도 유지되므로, 다른 검출기로 검출하는 대신 실행이 해당 선택을 받아 실행할 수 없는 이유를 알립니다.
